summary: Ellison Studios is a Sydney furniture design studio (founded 2017) that was online-only for almost a decade and has since opened a Sydney showroom (Design Suite) and a Melbourne residency (The Lobby, March 2026; a Melbourne Design Suite is coming). Sapna Trivedi is Finance Director (LinkedIn), and a trade program sits alongside online and stockist channels.

sources.title: Ellison Studios' Melbourne Pop-Up Feels Like A Luxe Hotel Lobby

claims.text: Ellison Studios is an Australian design studio based in Sydney, founded in 2017.
claims.quote: leading Australian design studio based in Sydney, Australia. Founded in 2017

claims.text: Sapna Trivedi is Finance Director at Ellison Studios (current since May 2025).
Sapna's profile says she is passionate about implementing financial rigour, improving processes and finding operational efficiencies.

people.name: Sapna Trivedi
people.title: Finance Director (listed as CFO in records)

hooks.text: Multi-channel growth (online, showroom, trade, stockist): receipts from several directions.
New physical sites in 2025-26 add locations to reconcile.
Sapna's stated focus on process improvement.

risks.text: LinkedIn shows Sapna Trivedi's title as Finance Director (not CFO) and she also lists a current CFO role at The Core Agency, so she may have limited time.
The Lobby is now closed per Ellison's page.

gaps: Sydney HQ opening date (Sept 2025) not confirmed from a citable source.
